label: bulwark picture: fighter fields
why: The picture's own state on the fighter (the bar folds past ultWall; a block's flash and an arrow's scorch outlive their step, and a stopped arrow is spliced before the picture can see it); never m.ultFx (open item 25). Read by nothing in the sim.

label: bulwark picture: the presentation call
why: tickPresentation runs through hit stops and after the match; one call to tickBulwark.

label: bulwark picture: tickBulwark
why: Drives the bar (rise at the cast, hold, fold 0.25s off ultWall && alive && !over) and finds each block and arrow by wallTally rising: a block flashes the bar for 2 frames; an arrow leaves a scorch at its place along the bar (from the shots' predicted positions, kept as plain numbers); a bank floats the vigil '+N' on the caster and, once a window, tags WARD. Writes presentation fields, floats, tags and taught only; no rng.

label: bulwark picture: the world call (over both fighters)
why: World pass, after both fighters: the wall stands in front of the sword and the ward ring, with every ball's disc cut out of it (CLAUDE.md 4.1b); bloom share 0.

label: bulwark picture: the drawing methods
why: drawBulwark and one method a component (halo, motes, body with the block flash, scorch), the bar rebuilt from the sim's own geometry at draw time and blended into the ward ring's arc for the rise and the fold.

label: bulwark picture: the nova's plate ring retired
why: drawUltUnder's lightkeeper branch was the NOVA's footprint (a tiled ring out to radius 300 for 1.5s at every cast); the nova is out (v107 stage 1), so its picture goes too.

label: bulwark picture: the nova's plates retired
why: drawUltOver's lightkeeper branch was the NOVA's eighteen plates thrown out to radius 300; retired with the nova.

label: bulwark picture: the charge rune
why: ULTSIG.lightkeeper drew the nova's expanding ring and a shield; now the five ward plates with a bar standing up out of their front as the charge fills and an arrow stopped against it.
